title: remote-control timeline fixture (test harness only)
description: Not a wire format. A recorded session used by component tests: the device and session summaries a client starts from, followed by the session.event frames the gateway delivers in order. Feed `frames` into a timeline reducer and compare the result with `session_final`.

session.description: The session summary before the first frame is applied.

session_final.description: The session summary after every frame has been applied.
